name: Succubus

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Brides of Death
abilities.text: All Threats that share a <WYCH CULT> Keyword within 5 metres of the Succubus gain +2 bonus dice to any Weapon Skill (I) Tests until the end of the Succubus' next Turn.

abilities.name: No Escape
abilities.text: When this Threat makes a Reaction Attack with a melee weapon they do so with +2 bonus dice.

determination: Lightning Dodge: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6 d6. This Threat uses Agility instead of Toughness to roll Determination, and can roll determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: Another printing exists: litanies-succubus (Litanies of the Lost). Print: the Agoniser's Inflict is printed "Poisoned, 35".
